title: achillea abrotanoides
intro: Achillea abrotanoides, commonly known as Yarrow or Scentless Yarrow, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety due to its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Achillea abrotanoides are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, making it effective in relieving menstrual cramps and other muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
